changelog:
- Initial release of home-memory skill.
- Enables agents to remember, store, recall, and search household context using BlueColumn persistent memory.
- Requires a BlueColumn API key (`bc_live_*`) for API access.
- Supports quick notes, storing summaries, and recalling household maintenance reminders.
- Includes setup instructions and workflow recommendations for integrating memory into home management tasks.
summary: Give AI agents Remember household context. using BlueColumn persistent memory. Use when an agent manages home tasks and maintenance; when the user wants to store, recall, or search home memory context. Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
